title: 1 Peter
author: Peter the apostle.
historicalSetting: Peter encourages suffering believers to hope in Christ, live holy lives, and endure faithfully.
keyVerse: 1 Peter 1:3 — "He has caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ."
christFocus: First Peter points to Christ as the suffering Savior, risen Lord, Shepherd, and source of living hope for suffering believers.
